title: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl let an on-path attacker choose the installed public…
description: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow an on-path attacker to manipulate the installed public suffix list by exploiting the module's update mechanism, which fetches the list over unprotected HTTP without integrity checks. This manipulation can persist until the module is reinstalled and may cause hostname verification to accept wildcard certificates improperly.
